answer: Require every agent identity to escrow a 380-unit bond and serve a twenty-three epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and collects four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent counterparties; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for nine rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 380 units per alias and replays twenty-three rounds, while a signal of matching traces betrays the ring, haven receipts certify reviews, and cedar history prevents recycling.
